description: Scores a Jira/Linear ticket for completeness against Definition of Ready: acceptance criteria, estimate, and the four cross-cutting dimensions.

scoring.scale: 0 = absent, 1 = partial (mentioned but vague), weight = fully present and concrete

dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.criterion: Acceptance criteria are written as verifiable Given-When-Then or numbered checklist items, not as task descriptions. Each criterion is independently testable. An implementer can write a test before touching code.
dimensions.gap_signal: AC section missing; or AC items are task descriptions ('implement the API') rather than verifiable outcomes ('returns 200 with a body matching the schema').

dimensions.name: Definition of Ready
dimensions.criterion: The ticket passes Definition of Ready: scope is bounded, context sufficient to start without a separate discovery session, and no external blockers are unresolved.
dimensions.gap_signal: Scope is unbounded ('improve the search'); key context is missing ('see Confluence') without a direct link; blockers are noted but unresolved.

dimensions.name: Estimate and sizing
dimensions.criterion: A story-point or T-shirt-size estimate is present. The estimate is consistent with the scope: a 1-pointer has trivially bounded scope; an 8-pointer has a split plan.
dimensions.gap_signal: No estimate; or estimate is wildly inconsistent with the visible scope.

dimensions.name: Risk coverage
dimensions.criterion: Top risks are listed (e.g., auth surface, data migration, external dependency). At least one mitigation or 'watch out for' note is present. Low-risk tickets may state 'no identified risks' with full credit.
dimensions.gap_signal: Ticket touches auth, tenancy, or data migration but no risks are listed.

dimensions.name: Test plan
dimensions.criterion: The ticket states what kind of tests will cover it — unit, integration, E2E, or 'covered by AC'. Edge cases and failure paths are named. 'TBD' fails this dimension.
dimensions.gap_signal: No test plan; or test plan is 'write tests' without specifying scope or edge cases.

dimensions.name: Dependencies
dimensions.criterion: Upstream and downstream dependencies are named (tickets, services, teams). Blocked-by links exist in the tracker. 'No dependencies' is acceptable with full credit when true.
dimensions.gap_signal: References to other work exist in the description text but are not linked in the tracker; or known blockers are undeclared.

dimensions.name: Maintainability considerations
dimensions.criterion: If the ticket introduces long-lived output (a new module, a schema change, a new public endpoint), ownership and refresh cadence are named. Short-lived or purely additive work is exempt (full credit).
dimensions.gap_signal: A new long-lived module or schema is introduced with no named owner or documentation note.
